dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: This is the recon bot from that day! But, Krum-Clank isn't here...

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Yep... Pretty much what I expected. When they made their initial escape, they took the recon bot with them to cover their tracks.

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: But it's exhausting to travel with that kind of cargo. So, once they made it far enough, they dropped the recon bot and ran off with Krum-Clank. I doubt they expected anyone to search this area.

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: I bet these footprints are from when they fled this location.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Is that enough to tell where they went?

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Hmm... Enough to give us some clues, at least. I see a special kind of sand in the footprints. It clearly isn't from any of the areas we've passed through so far.

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: If I'm right, they probably tracked the sand in from somewhere else... somewhere they go a lot... like their hideout.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: A special kind of sand... Wait, near the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau on Paha Isle, there's a place called Maroon Basin. There's a huge beach there!

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Then that's where we should head next.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Wow, Melusines are awesome! I want one!

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Melusines are people, not pets, Aino...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that's the last clue we needed, right? Let's get going!
